coverage_assessment: All 16 native noul jobs and all six exact source selections reviewed. Eight true and eight false expectations independently derived. Limited balanced development diagnostic; does not establish source-discovery recall, generalization, calibration, or completion of the broader goal.
source_assessment: Every capture hash and Unicode span matches exactly. Surrounding source was checked. Selected evidence contains the defining clauses, exclusions, or condition relationships each question asks about. Subdivision (a) recovery is unnecessary to identify the expressly stated not-released condition; operational application would require that separate source.
atomicity_assessment: Each question judges one candidate definition, detail, condition-membership proposition, necessity proposition or disjunction relation. j005/j006 and j007/j008 retain coordinated pairs governed by the same explicit inclusion/exclusion; no competing answers arise within them. j013 is membership of an alternative, not sufficiency for the full duty. j015 and j016 separately test necessity and OR structure.
native_instruction_assessment: Questions and candidate/term fields are explicit in each native noul instructions object. Neutral IDs and field-only licenses do not carry labels. The registry supplies model/build identity; its separate triage instructions must not replace these job-specific instructions. No inference or dispatch performed.

grouping_assessment.reason: Jobs sharing the same exact evidence may be grouped under the reviewed plan mechanism. No job depends on another answer; each field-only license records only its own judgment. Grouped opposite candidates can cue each other, so results diagnose this grouped configuration rather than isolated-question performance.

policy_assessment: All jobs consistently use true_at_least 0.9 and false_at_most 0.1. These are routing thresholds, not evidence of calibration.
limits: The rent questions address only security deposits and fees, not the scope of incorporated utility/service-charge provisions.
Definition detail questions do not establish chapter applicability to a live matter.
The source supplies additional conjunctive conditions for reclaiming property; a positive claimant-component answer cannot alone authorize release or waive charges.
No author expectations, parent experiment controls, prior responses, comparisons or adjudications were read.
